_comment: Data/Content/course-plan.json - the course's description, which module each week belongs to and its focus. Hand-written in Data/Source/course-plan.json; `npm run build:content` checks it and writes it here. Part of the course, so it travels with the content: GET /api/course returns it as `plan` (null when the course has none). It lists every week of the course, written or not; a planned week with no built days shows as 'opens soon'.

description._comment: Shown under the course's name on the course index. May be empty.

modules._comment: Keyed by a short module key that weeks refer to.

color._comment: A plain hex colour, #RRGGBB: it is used as a CSS colour, so nothing else is accepted.

module._comment: One of the keys in modules.
